fusions.name: Rattle Through the Herd
fusions.desc: A rattled warning deals 26 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Lowered Head
fusions.desc: A headbutt that deals 5 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Chewing It Over
fusions.desc: You restore 10 health at once and 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Anger
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
